notes: Native browser only for Onshape interaction; source inspection is not marked as UI verification.
All comparison steps must be run in Chili3D; unresolved steps stay pending or blocked.
An attempted rectangle dimension did not open an input; its value has not been changed or verified.
Search tool modal Escape initially clears its search input instead of closing the modal; used its X button to close.
Square profiles are cursor-drawn approximations, not numerically equal test fixtures; no exact shape/volume parity claim is made from these UI runs.

Read-only app inspection confirmed zero Loft sections after tree/region picks, two sections and Failed to loft after edge picks, and the failed EditableShapeNode after confirmation. Geometry creation remained through UI clicks.
